summary: A single reference line that makes Vite's type definitions available to the type checker.
purpose: Lets the code use features Vite adds, such as importing asset files, without type errors.
why: Likely reason: standard setup for projects built with Vite.
how: The line points the type checker to Vite's built-in type definitions. Nothing runs at run time.
outputs: None at run time. It only affects type checking.
risks: Removing it can cause type errors wherever Vite features are used.
debug: If Vite-specific imports show type errors, check that this line is still present and that Vite is installed.
